items.summary: Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchm

items.title: WindBorne wins a hefty US Air Force contract for its balloon data
items.summary: A Silicon Valley startup that uses weather balloons and AI to predict the weather won a U.S. military contract worth almost $50 million.

items.title: Honeyjar offers AI tools to improve PR and comms at every company
items.summary: Journalists, entrepreneurs, and even some public relations professionals will tell you that the PR process is broken. But could AI actually make things better?

items.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
items.summary: Microsoft president Brad Smith calls for urgent AI regulation, saying milk and washing machines have more oversight than AI companies.

items.title: This AI startup says it can generate permit-ready blueprints in minutes
items.summary: Blueprints AI, a bootstrapped startup based in Santa Monica, developed software that produces code-compliant construction blueprints from a photo, PDF, or sketc

items.title: 为人民币汇率发声 央行首次系统阐明政策立场
items.summary: 10月8日，《中国人民银行关于人民币汇率的政策立场》(以下简称《立场》)发布，强调中国实施以市场供求为基础、参考一篮子货币进行调节、有管理的浮动汇率制度，坚持让市场在汇率形成中发挥决定性作用。这是央行首次系统阐明人民币汇率的政策立场。

items.title: 新华社快讯：IMF上调2026年世界经济增长预期至3.1%
items.summary: 新华社快讯：国际货币基金组织(IMF)13日小幅上调2026年世界经济增长预期至3.1%，较7月预测值高0.1个百分点。IMF说，人工智能(AI)投资热潮对部分经济体的提振抵消了中东冲突对其他一些经济体的拖累。

items.title: 商务部就《民用航空领域相关两用物项出口凭证管理办法》（征求意见稿）答记者问
items.summary: 中新网10月13日电 据商务部网站消息，近期，商务部就《民用航空领域相关两用物项出口凭证管理办法》(以下简称《办法》)(征求意见稿)面向社会公开公开征求意见。商务部安全与管制局负责人就推动《办法》立法的有关问题回答了记者提问。

items.title: 中国进出口银行今年前三季度投放外贸领域贷款近万亿元
items.summary: 今年前三个季度，中国进出口银行新发放外贸领域贷款近万亿元，同比增长9%，其中近40%投向稳外贸主体和稳外贸产业链领域。

items.summary: 10月13日，全国大遗址工作会在河南郑州召开。会议总结“十四五”期间大遗址工作成绩，部署“十五五”重点任务。

items.title: 地面战斗白热化，胡塞武装围困上万也门政府军
items.summary: 中新网10月13日电(记者 刁炜)沙特民航部门发表声明称，该国哈立德国王国际机场10日遭胡塞武装导弹袭击，造成至少12人丧生、309人受伤。

items.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
items.summary: It comes after the armed group hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.

items.title: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34
items.summary: Mitte, who lived with cerebral palsy, starred as Walter White Jr in the Emmy-winning drama series.

items.title: Immigration agents search congresswoman Ilhan Omar's home
items.summary: Omar, an outspoken Trump critic, said the search was "an attempt to target political enemies" and she "will not be silenced".
